CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
January 24, 2023 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
RECOGNITION OF THE WEST COAST WARRIORS CROSS COUNTRY RUNNING TEAM - It is recommended the City Council recognize the athletes and coaches of the West Coast Warriors Cross County Running Team's 9-10 age division and present them with Certificates of Recognition.
6.1 Recognition of West Coast Warriors
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of January 10, 2023 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of January 10, 2023.
7.1 Minutes of 1-10-23 SS
7.1 Minutes of 1-10-23 CC
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated January 24, 2023 in the total amount of $3,983,080.82.
7.2 Warrant Register
7.3
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING DECEMBER 2022 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending December 2022.
7.3 Investment Report
7.4
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING NOVEMBER 2022 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending November 2022.
7.4 Treasurer Report
7.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-07, SANTA GERTRUDES AVENUE CORRIDOR TRAFFIC SIGNAL UPGRADES – REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2018-07, Santa Gertrudes Avenue Corridor Traffic Signal Upgrades, to Select Electric, Inc., in the amount of $565,465.00; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the on-call engineering contracts for construction survey, inspection and testing services in an amount not to exceed 20 percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total construction cost.
7.5 CIP No. 2018-07
7.6
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-08, PHASE 6B RESIDENTIAL STREET REHABILITATION - ACCEPTANCE OF WORK AND APPROVAL OF BALANCING CONTRACT CHANGE ORDER NO. 2 - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by R.J. Noble Company; authorize the City Manager to execute Balancing Contract Change Order No. 2 in the amount of $112,387.63; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the agreement.
7.6 CIP No. 2018-08
7.7
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-03, IMPERIAL HIGHWAY PAVEMENT REHABILITATION FROM VALLEY VIEW AVENUE TO WICKER DRIVE - REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2018-03, Imperial Highway Pavement Rehabilitation Eastbound from Valley View Avenue to Wicker Drive, to All American Asphalt in the amount of $945,000; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the on-call engineering agreements for construction support services in an amount not to exceed ten percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total construction contract cost.
7.7 CIP No. 2018-03
7.8
APPROVAL OF THE NORWALK-LA MIRADA UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT'S "LA MIRADA ALL CITY SCHOOLS CONCERT" AT LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council approve the Norwalk-La Mirada Unified School District's "La Mirada All City Schools Concert" at La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts and waive the associated fees.
7.8 Approval of Use of Theatre
7.9
APPROVAL OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF’S DEPARTMENT “MUG RUN” – It is recommended the City Council approve the Sheriff’s Department “Mug Run” subject to conditions recommended by staff.
7.9 LASD Mug Run
8.
PUBLIC HEARING
8.1
COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT PROGRAM (CDBG) PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2023-24 PROJECTS - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law; approve the proposed Fiscal Year 2023-24 Community Development Block Grant projects as presented; and authorize the City Manager to execute the contracts and any amendments with the Los Angeles County Development Authority on behalf of the City.
8.1 FY 2023-24 CDBG Projects
8.2
RESOLUTION NO. 23-01 APPROVING CERTIFICATE OF COMPATIBILITY NO. 66 TO CONSTRUCT A NEW 143,617 SQUARE FOOT INDUSTRIAL WAREHOUSE BUILDING ON THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 16930 VALLEY VIEW AVENUE (APN 7003-011-026), WITHIN THE INDUSTRIAL (M-2) ZONING DISTRICT - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as required by law; affirm the CEQA Exemption; and adopt Resolution No. 23-01 approving Certificate of Compatibility No. 66 to construct a new 143,617 square foot industrial warehouse building at 16930 Valley View Avenue within the Industrial (M-2) Zoning District.
8.2 PH: Reso. No. 23-01
8.3
ORDINANCE NO. 728 ADOPTING ZONING ORDINANCE AMENDMENT NO. 55, ADDING LAND USE REGULATIONS APPLICABLE TO MICRO-BREWERY FACILITIES, TO TITLE 21 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE (ZONING ORDINANCE), AND TO TABLE 6.1 OF THE IMPERIAL HIGHWAY SPECIFIC PLAN; AND APPROVING AN EXEMPTION FROM THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA) PURSUANT TO SECTION 15061(b)(3) OF THE CEQA GUIDELINES - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as required by law and consider all public testimony regarding the proposed Zoning Ordinance Amendment No. 55; affirm the CEQA Exemption; and introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 728 adopting Zoning Ordinance Amendment No. 55, adding land use regulations applicable to micro-brewery facilities, to Title 21 of the La Mirada Municipal Code (Zoning Ordinance), and to Table 6.1 of the Imperial Highway Specific Plan; and approving an exemption from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) of the CEQA guidelines, by title only, and waive further reading.
8.3 PH: Ord. No. 728
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 23-02 AUTHORIZING A BUDGET AMENDMENT FOR CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-03, IMPERIAL HIGHWAY PAVEMENT REHABILITATION FROM VALLEY VIEW AVENUE TO WICKER DRIVE – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 23-02 authorizing a budget amendment for Capital Improvement Project No. 2018-03, Imperial Highway Pavement Rehabilitation from Valley View Avenue to Wicker Drive in the amount of $530,000.
9.1 Reso. No. 23-02
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 23-03 ADOPTING THE CITY OF LA MIRADA 2022 LOCAL HAZARD MITIGATION PLAN - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 23-03 adopting the City of La Mirada 2022 Local Hazard Mitigation Plan.
9.2 Reso. No. 23-03
9.2 LHMP Doc.
